title: A diminished triad plus a seventh

steps.title: A diminished triad plus a seventh
steps.body:
**half-diminished chord** means a diminished triad plus a minor seventh. Bm7b5 has B, D, F and A. The written b5 lowers the fifth of Bm7 from F# to F.

**Why it matters:** The full symbol tells you which sound is lowered while the minor seventh stays.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: Play strings 5 through 2 at frets 2, 3, 2 and 3. They sound B, F, A and D. Leave both outer strings out. One finger spans strings 5 through 3 at fret 2; another finger supplies fret 3 on string 4.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: Find F# in another position and compare it with F. Only F belongs to Bm7b5; do not include both in the app check.
